question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 9 \\ -12\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ -8 \\ 16\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ -4 \\ 32\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that  

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 9 \\ -12\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ -8 \\ 16\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ -4 \\ 32\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The equation above gives the system with the augmented matrix 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}3 & -4 & -8 \\ 9 & -8 & -4 \\ -12 & 16 & 32\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the matrix using Gaussian elimination, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -4 & -8 \\ 9 & -8 & -4 \\ -12 & 16 & 32\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & -4 & -8 \\ 0 & 4 & 20 \\ -12 & 16 & 32\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & -4 & -8 \\ 0 & 4 & 20 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

 

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-4{x}_{2}=-8 \\ 4{x}_{2}=20.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get ${x}_{2}=5.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we obtain

$$
3{x}_{1}-4(5)=-8\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=4.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 5\end{aligned}].$

Finally, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=4+5=9.$
